faq.q: What is an AI product background changer?
faq.a: It keeps your product photo and replaces the setting around the item. You describe the surface or the room, then download a new image.

faq.q: Can I make a new background for an Etsy photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one product photo, name the surface or the room, and download the square image. The cost shows before the job starts.
The item should keep its angle and outline. Compare it with the real product, because small print can shift.

faq.q: Do I get a transparent cut-out?
faq.a: No. You get a complete photo with the new setting already in place. For a plain listing field, make a separate white image.
Simple surfaces keep attention on the item: light wood, stone, linen, or one quiet color. A busy scene makes the product harder to see.

faq.q: Can I use the new photo in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Add any price or offer in your ad editor.

faq.q: Can I choose a seasonal or outdoor setting?
faq.a: Yes. Name one room, surface, or outdoor scene, such as a holiday shelf or a shaded table.

faq.q: How is this different from a reshoot?
faq.a: A reshoot needs space and lights. Here the new setting comes from a photo you already own. If that photo is blurry, start with [how to take product photos for AI](page:guide-product-photo-tips).

faq.q: Do you include a library of free backgrounds?
faq.a: No. You name the surface or the room yourself. Each photo uses 24 credits, and there is no free background pack.
